matches.integration_en: Keep Chaos's vivid dark red armor, charcoal limbs, gold fork-shaped chest accent, paired swept horns on the helmet and shoulders. Fuse HAYABUSA's central forehead ridge, flared brow blade roots, continuous narrow visor and layered shoulder plates with the original. Recast the huge curling horns as short swept fin-like guards, two at the helmet and two short shoulder tips, never animal antlers. Use a single amber smoked visor under a red brow and a closed charcoal jaw. Gold branching chest design becomes a shallow split reinforcing trim around a red chest yoke, not molten skin. Articulated ribs and black textile abdomen, restrained blade-shaped forearms, human boots. Recompose the crown and shoulder layer pattern; no copied mask or katana.

matches.integration_en: Preserve DEC.24's cherry-red armor, white brow and jaw frame, white forearm faces and boot edge trim, pale green-gold glass, and the small warm yellow chest insets. Fuse HAZOP's clear wraparound human visor, rounded low crown, enclosed breathing jaw and compact side filters. Rebuild the white jaw into two small rectangular filters flanking one central closed mouth cover; no exposed face, no robot eyes. Keep the red helmet cap smooth and low. Chest consists of red upper panels around two small yellow status windows, sloped white-edged support straps and an articulated red abdomen. A short detachable red weather hood folded at the nape with a small white closure recalls the original festive tail, no floppy Santa hat. Dark woven joints, compact squared shoulder caps, normal human gloves. New seam arrangement; no camouflage or UNSC logos.

matches.integration_en: User revision: restore and improve the ORIGINAL Star Warfare helmet as the primary design. Preserve the current redesigned body. Knight must preserve the original broad outward-flared angular brim, raised pointed crown, two short horns and broad lime visor. Improve thickness, liner and cheek/neck joints only; do not substitute the PREFECT helmet. Halo remains a body and attachment construction donor, not the helmet authority.

matches.initial_integration_en: Preserve Knight's blue-black armor, acid-lime glass visor and thin shoulder edge accents, orange cloth neck insert, broad rimmed brow, and two small crown points. Fuse PREFECT's clean long faceted crown, inward cheek planes and V-shaped chest frame, but replace the reference's narrow vertical face window with Knight's WIDE continuous lime-smoked human visor. Crown should have one low central wedge with two short raised corner tabs, not a bucket or robot head. Flared low brow over glass, enclosed lower cheek cradle. Large dark steel chest facets with thin lime shoulder edging, short layered waist plates, angular grooved forearms, human articulated hands and knees. Borrow twin flat upper-back rails but shorten them and create a separate low service latch; no full length mechanical spine. Keep orange neck cloth visible as a small insert, not scarf around the helmet. No copied emblems or tan coating.

matches.integration_en: Preserve R.O.M.E's crimson-red armor and silver structural panels, recognisable longitudinal red crest, silver crown top, smoky gold wide visor, round silver chest fitting, rounded shoulder badge, and white chevron forearms. Fuse ACHILLES's lowered brow, layered cheek enclosure, angular chest frame and articulated thigh plates. Shorten the original tall fan crest into a low continuous forward-to-back red helmet ridge mounted over a silver crown cap. A closed red cheek frame surrounds a broad continuous smoked-gold HUMAN visor, no nose or teeth. Integrate one small round silver chest access cover in a newly split red chest plate; keep forearm chevrons broad but shaped as replaceable white plates. Red shin plates have one thin off-white vertical strip. Shoulders rounded over shorter layered wing plates, not giant sharp fins. Flexible black neck, waist and limbs; no spear, sword, gladiator skirt, exact reference crest or logo.

matches.integration_en: Keep Black Hole's almost-black charcoal armor, restrained cyan glass and tiny seam accents, short central crown ridge, compact rectangular forearm guards and scale-like overlapping outer-thigh plates. Fuse LOCUS's enclosing helmet shell, shallow X-like brow-cheek junctions and round ear coupling into a HUMAN helmet, but explicitly replace the skeletal nose, teeth-like vent and separate robot eyes with a SINGLE continuous narrow cyan-smoked visor and simple sealed chin. Draw the X-like structure only as the angle where brow meets cheek, not a huge white X. Shorten original sharp rear-crown points into one low ridge and two tiny rear tabs. Make the chest dark broad floating plates on visible black fabric, with a small cyan triangular collar fitting. Shoulders compact and rounded at the top, new asymmetrical service latch on one chest panel; never red/white Locus coating. Matte surfaces separated by subtle gray value differences so armor is readable, no luminous full-body circuits, no robotic joints.

matches.integration_en: Preserve X-Field's brick-coral red shell, turquoise ear frames and chest fittings, icy cyan glass and broad honeycomb-pattern shoulder inserts, plus the wide flat rear-extended crown. Fuse PROTECTOR's continuous central crown spine, human eye-level visor recess, armored cheek cradle, U-shaped chest yoke and discrete shoulder mounts. Keep the flat crown wider than tall and extend it just a little over the rear neck, no exaggerated robot brow. The visor is one clear blue glass band; lower face is a short sealed red/graphite mask. Both shoulder caps have visible recessed light-blue hexagonal ceramic cells in a turquoise rim, physical replaceable panels rather than glowing force fields. Thick red chest plates step down to soft black waist, turquoise latch at collar; angular red thighs and shins with dark knee pads. Reduce extraneous cyan lines. No copied chest eagle, reference coating stripes or weapon.

matches.integration_en: Preserve Wrath's steel-blue and silver armor, dark curved double brow horns, central gold diamond fitting, narrow red visor, layered silver shoulders and small gold knee frames. Fuse YOROI KABUTO's rounded human helmet dome, side cheek and nape lamellae, raised forehead ornament roots, and stacked shoulder structure. Transform Wrath's huge looping horns into two short curved thick brow rails growing from the gold central diamond; silhouette must still show the pair, each under a quarter helmet height. Use one narrow continuous red-smoked glass visor with simple closed blue/silver jaw, no oni face, teeth, eyes or beard. Replace original long shoulder leaves with three short silver overlapping plates seated on blue shoulder caps; keep a small round outer-arm connector. Steel-blue chest has two offset silver reinforcing bands and one small gold diamond, flexible black waist, no samurai cloth skirt, no katana. Normal human gloves, tapered shins and armored boots. Recompose panel layout and avoid copying Kabuto ornament outline or red/gold coating.
